tools.name: skilldb_search
tools.description: Search the public SkillDB catalog for reusable AI-agent guidance relevant to task keywords, with optional category and pack filters. Returns paginated metadata and public catalog links. Does not return complete instructions or private skills.

tools.name: skilldb_get_preview
tools.description: Retrieve metadata and a short public excerpt for one exact public skill ID. The excerpt is limited to 203 characters and may be truncated. Returns public catalog links and preview access status, not complete instructions, account data, or private or paid content.
